## v0.1.0 — 2026-05-20

First release — initial corpus snapshot.

### Rules added

- `global-clean-architecture` — Clean Architecture Layer Boundaries and Dependency Inversion
- `global-logging-telemetry` — Logging and Telemetry — Structured JSON, Trace Context, Redaction
- `global-security-baselines` — Security Baselines — Secrets, Input Boundaries, and OWASP Top 10 Anchors
- `java-spring-config-disable-open-session-in-view` — Disable Open-Session-In-View
- `java-spring-controller-dto-record-mandate` — Mandatory Request and Response Record Types at the Controller Boundary
- `java-spring-controller-pageable-defaults` — Mandatory Pageable Defaults on Controller List Endpoints
- `java-spring-controller-validation-boundaries` — Mandatory @Valid and @Validated on Controller Boundaries
- `java-spring-di-constructor-injection-mandate` — Constructor Injection Mandate — No Field or Setter @Autowired
- `java-spring-error-handling-problem-details-rfc7807` — RFC 7807 ProblemDetail as the Wire Format on Spring Boot 3+
- `java-spring-error-handling-prohibit-blind-catch` — Prohibition of Blind/Generic Catch Blocks
- `java-spring-error-handling-prohibit-generic-runtime` — Prohibition of Generic Runtime Exceptions
- `java-spring-error-handling-unified-api-error` — Unified ApiErrorResponse Contract for All REST Error Pathways
- `java-spring-repository-entity-graph-strategy` — EntityGraph Over JOIN FETCH for Pagination-Safe Eager Loading
- `java-spring-repository-findall-pagination-mandate` — Mandatory Pageable on All List-Returning Repository Methods
- `java-spring-repository-n-plus-one-prevention` — N+1 Select Prevention via Fetch Strategy and BatchSize
- `java-spring-service-self-invocation-trap` — Prohibition of Self-Invocation Across Transactional Proxy Boundaries
- `java-spring-service-transactional-boundaries` — Disciplined @Transactional Boundaries — No External I/O Inside Transactions
- `java-spring-service-transactional-readonly` — Read-Only Default at the Service Class Level
